_comment: License policy for the dependency scan (scripts/license/license_scan.py). allow: no action. review: compatible with AGPL-3.0 or conditionally so, needs a human look the first time. deny: incompatible with an AGPL app or not open source. Unknown or missing licenses are treated as deny in --enforce mode.

package_overrides._comment: Exact 'ecosystem:name' -> SPDX expression, for packages whose metadata is missing or wrong. Record the reason in the PR that adds an entry.
